name: webgpu-tensorflow-service
description: TensorFlow.js + WebGPU style-transfer service exposing a binary TCP protocol on 127.0.0.1:7878

scripts.generate:types: rimraf generated/types && jco guest-types wit/ -o generated/types
scripts.setup:wit: npm run fetch:wit && npm run generate:types
scripts.build:component: jco componentize dist/service.js --wit wit --world-name service --backend qjs -o dist/service.wasm
scripts.build: npm run setup:wit && npm run build:ts && npm run build:component
